sources.snippet: In this release we are opening the weights of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series. sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Open Weight Released Aug 26 2026 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is an AI model released by Qwen on Wednesday, Aug 26 2026, 12 days after Qwen3.8-27B. It is an open-weight model — the trained weights are available to download and run. It is a 125B parameter model with a 262k token context window.
